jobs_results.description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.



Job Description-


IT Test Engineer I :


We are currently seeking  highly skilled software testers  to join our team. In this position, you will create and execute scenarios based on business requirements and validate the product works as per business requirements and customer needs. 


Duties & Responsibilities:


• Analyzes requirements, coordinates with BA’s / Subject Matter Experts.


• Identifies test conditions and / or creates test cases.


• Conducts and/or participates in peer reviews of test cases and test plans.


• Creates / Conditions test data for test execution.


• Executes tests according to the Test Plans.


• Documents test results and report defects.


• Evaluates test results.


• Retests, validates and closes applicable issue type as appropriate.


• Validates release notes.


• Submits daily status report.


• Identifies and reports risks.


• Coordinates Onshore / Offshore as needed.


• All assigned courses pertaining to new technical / domain / learning tasks are accomplished within defined time frame. 


Education and Other Credentials:



 BE /BSc  Degree or equivalent experience
 Certification, formal training in software testing and related fields 

 Skills and Qualifications



 0.6 to 3 years’ experience in functional testing
 HealthCare background is a plus.
 Experience working in TFS or similar tools . 
 Knowledge of Automation tools would be plus.
 Knowledge of quality assurance policies and procedures and general Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) principles.
 Demonstrated ability to visualize and create end-to-end test scenarios along with functional and Regression test plans.
 Experience with MS SQL Server, Oracle and proficiency in writing SQL Queries.
 Strong software troubleshooting and software problem analysis skills
 Effective oral and written communication skills.
 Ability to handle multiple activities with changing priorities simultaneously and escalate risks.
 Competency to utilize Company software and proficiency in Microsoft software applications and willingness to learn new systems as necessary.
 Ability to work in a dynamic and Fast Paced Environment.
 Ability to function as a team player and to be a self-starter. 

 


Conduent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national origin, age, gender identity, gender expression, sex/gender, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, use of a guide dog or service animal, military/veteran status, citizenship status, basis of genetic information, or any other group protected by law.

Complete the form and then email it as an attachment to FTADAAA@conduent.com. You may also click here to access Conduent's ADAAA Accommodation Policy.

jobs_results.description:
Job Summary


We are hiring a Software Testing Trainer to deliver our Manual and Automation Testing programs. Whether you are a bright fresher with strong testing fundamentals and project exposure or a professional with up to 2 years of experience, if you love teaching and can make testing concepts practical and simple, we want to hear from you. Freshers with strong fundamentals are encouraged to apply — structured trainer onboarding will be provided.


Key Responsibilities



 Deliver engaging classroom and online training sessions in Manual Testing, SDLC/STLC, test case design, and defect management
 Teach Automation Testing using Selenium with Java/Python, TestNG, and frameworks used in the industry
 Cover API testing (Postman), database testing (SQL), and basics of performance testing tools
 Introduce students to Agile/Scrum practices and defect tracking tools like JIRA
 Guide students through hands-on projects, real-world testing scenarios, and capstone projects
 Prepare and update course materials, assignments, assessments, and lab exercises in line with industry trends
 Mentor students on resume building and support interview preparation for QA roles
 Evaluate student progress and provide constructive feedback and doubt-clearing support
 Support demo sessions, workshops, and seminars conducted by the academy

Requirements



 Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
 0–2 years of experience in software testing (manual/automation) or technical training
 Strong understanding of testing concepts, SDLC/STLC, and test documentation
 Working knowledge of Selenium, Java or Python basics, SQL, and tools like Postman and JIRA
 Excellent presentation and communication skills in English; Malayalam is an advantage
 Genuine passion for teaching and mentoring students
 ISTQB or equivalent testing certification is a plus

What We Offer



 Competitive salary with growth into senior trainer roles
 Continuous upskilling in the latest testing tools and automation frameworks
 A platform to build your personal brand as a technology educator
 Supportive, learning-focused work culture

About Us


SMEC Technologies is Kerala's leading IT training academy, backed by over 25 years of parent-company experience in engineering and industrial solutions. With centres in Kochi, Calicut, and Trivandrum, we deliver industry-focused programs in Software Testing (Manual + Automation), Full Stack Development, Data Science, AI & ML, and UI/UX Design — built around hands-on projects and placement assistance.


Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month


Work Location: In person
